items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 29 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
Areas of light freezing rain are possible this morning from north
of Palmer along the Glenn Highway to Sutton and Chickaloon.
Temperatures overnight have fallen into the upper 20s to lower 30s
for this area with temperatures expected to remain steady through
mid to late morning before slowly warming above freezing. Any
precipitation is expected to be very light. However, a glaze ice
accumulation is possible across this area.

items.instruction:
A Winter Storm Warning for snow means severe winter weather
conditions will make travel very hazardous. If you must travel, keep
an extra flashlight, food and water in your vehicle in case of an
emergency.

For the latest road conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 29 at 5:36AM AKDT until October 31 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 1 PM this afternoon to 7 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

night into Friday morning.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 29 at 5:31AM AKDT until October 31 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2.5 to 3.5 feet above the normal high
tide expected during the Thursday and Friday high tides.

* WHERE...Hooper Bay.

* WHEN...From 7 AM Thursday to 1 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Beach property, the lowest buildings, & the access
road may be impacted. Multiple high tide cycles above normal
may lead to localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water levels of around 1 to 3 feet above
the normal high tide line are expected along the rest of the
Yukon Delta Coast
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 29 at 5:19AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
With periods of light rain and temperatures just below freezing
this morning, some slick spots have developed on roads and
sidewalks in Fairbanks and surrounding areas. Travelers should
proceed with extra caution. Conditions should improve by this
afternoon as temperatures warm and melt the ice.
items.areas: Tanana Flats; Eielson AFB and Salcha; Goldstream Valley and Nenana Hills; Chatanika River Valley; Two Rivers; Fairbanks Metro Area; Nenana
